title: Appending a symbol to a stored word
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word and let $b$ be a Boolean value. Updating the tape that stores $w$ at cell $|w|$ to contain $b$ yields the tape that stores the concatenation of $w$ with the one-symbol word $[b]$.
